Adaptation · Survival · Strength Earned Through Mutation

UNLOCK — "Petition the Firstscar" (6th level, requires surviving a fight your Feral Bond should have lost) opens access to Firstscar's Blessing at 18th level.

Every apex predator in the Glasslands carries a piece of the same scar tissue, passed down from whatever first creature adapted fast enough to survive the initial fallout and kept adapting ever since. The Firstscar isn't one animal — it's the pattern underneath all of them, occasionally visible as a shape at the edge of vision that's built from the worst parts of everything that's tried to kill you out there.

It doesn't grant magic. It grants the certainty that whatever's wrong with you now made you harder to kill, and that's worth something.
